result.summary: Re-gate of the follow-up fix commit d2fa122 (plus handoff bookkeeping commit 2420149) on top of the already-PASSed original build (see step-02c-security-reviewer.json, commit 8e8122a). Read git show d2fa122 and git show 2420149 myself, and independently diffed 8e8122a..HEAD to confirm total changed-file scope: apps/bot/src/i18n/formatTimeInTimezone.ts, apps/bot/src/i18n/formatTimeInTimezone.test.ts, apps/bot/src/domain/event.test.ts, plus handoffs/WF02-REQ-017/step-02-backend-dev-rework1.json and handoffs/WF02-REQ-017/step-02b-reviewer-regate.json -- nothing else. No handler, domain non-test source, migration, or config file outside that list changed. The only production-code edit is one line in formatTimeInTimezone.ts: hourCycle: 'h23' added to the Intl.DateTimeFormat options object already reviewed and PASSed under S1-S14 in the original gate. This is a pure output-formatting change to an already-approved, already-non-PII-leaking timestamp string (event start/agenda times, public event metadata, no Registration/User/EventStaff fields involved) -- it changes 'X:XX PM' to 'HH:MM' for the same instant, timezone, and locale inputs; it does not change what data is read, what is written, what is logged, who can reach the code path, or any consent/authorization/token/export logic. Re-verified the specific security-relevant properties the original PASS covered still hold post-fix: (1) the function takes no user-controlled timezone/locale beyond the pre-existing BotLang/chapter-timezone parameters already validated in the earlier gate -- no new input surface; (2) grep of the 3 changed files for PII field names (phone/email/employer) and for new console.log/error/warn/info/AuditLog call sites returns nothing; (3) no new branches, role checks, or database queries were added -- the diff is confined to a formatter options object and literal string assertions in tests. S4-S10, S12, S14: N/A, unchanged from original gate (no qr_token/InviteCode/check-in/capacity/notification/export/Profile/publish_consent code touched). S13: N/A, no migration files in this diff (git diff --stat confirms no .sql/schema changes) -- no sign-off duty triggered. S11: no new logging introduced. S1-S3: unaffected -- the consent-gating and chapter-scoping logic verified in the original gate is untouched by this diff (git diff 8e8122a..HEAD touches only i18n formatting + its own tests, not start.ts's consent flow or event.ts's chapterId filtering). Independently reproduced current state on commit 2420149: npm run lint (0 errors, 2 pre-existing unrelated warnings in apps/web/Footer.tsx and Nav.tsx, none in apps/bot), npm run build -w apps/bot (tsc clean), npx vitest run --root apps/bot (16 test files, 204/204 tests passed). All applicable S1-S14 items PASS or correctly N/A with reason given -- no silent skips. Routing note: this is not new TEST-DESIGNER rework. TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR originally FAILed at Step 3b because the test spec's 24-hour assertions were correct against REQ-017's design doc but the implementation (formatDateTimeInTimezone) silently produced 12-hour en-US output -- the defect was in the code, not the spec. BACKEND-DEV's fix (d2fa122) makes the implementation match the spec's original correct expectations; REVIEWER already re-gated and confirmed scope (step-02b-reviewer-regate.json). Nothing here requires TEST-DESIGNER to revise assertions -- they were right the first time. The correct next step is TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR re-running Step 3b against the now-fixed code to confirm the original spec now passes end-to-end, not a new TEST-DESIGNER authoring pass.
